$comment: The review of 1790, Adam's to correct. Each entry is [the name an English writer of 1790 would have used, or null if the thing was not there then; today's name, to read by; why, where they differ]. Where English had no name of its own, today's stands, unless it honours someone born after 1790 and an older name is known. The towns, keyed by Wikidata id, reviewed by an agent against Natural Earth's populated places: on 2026-10-06 the 522 it ranks highest today and some two hundred more that mattered then, and from 2026-10-07 the rest region by region - Europe. A town not listed here is not yet reviewed and is not carried into the world; one the reviewer could not date is left out rather than guessed. The rivers, keyed as world:names keys them - a Wikidata id where Natural Earth gives one, otherwise its file, number and name - reviewed on 2026-10-07: a river not listed keeps the source's name, today's, and a canal is carried only where it is listed with a name. Read by world:names; see docs/plans/real-world-names.md.
